description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 or 457.50 each) capped at 19,999 based on ATK and MAG. Grants [Crystal Force Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode: Wedge] to user. Grants [Attach Wind with Stacking]/[Attach Poison with Stacking] based on if entry damage was Wind/Poison.

description.name: Crystal Force I
description.text: Eight single attacks (2.00 or 990.00 each) capped at 19,999 based on ATK and MAG. Grants [Soul Break Gauge +250], [Instant ATB 1] to user. Grants [Attach Wind with Secondary Stacking]/[Attach Poison with Secondary Stacking].

description.name: Crystal Force II
description.text: Eight single attacks (2.00 or 990.00 each) capped at 19,999 based on ATK and MAG. Grants [Damage Cap +10000 3], [Quick Cast 3], [Wind, Poison Ability +30% Boost 3], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 3], [Instant ATB 1] to user.

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Wedge
description.text: Wind/Poison abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind/Poison abilities trigger 1 additional time, [DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)], removed if user hasn't Crystal Force Mode

description.name: DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)
description.text: Ignores 25% of the target's DEF and RES

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Attach Poison with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Poison Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Poison 3
